name: image-evaluation-v3
adjudicate_when: judges disagree on any hard-failure class
the ordering of tournament branches changes under either judge

rating_anchors.10: Exceptional and nearly unassailable at original resolution; no visible defect in this dimension.
rating_anchors.9: Excellent; only an insignificant local imperfection that does not weaken credibility.
rating_anchors.8: Strong professional result with one small but clearly nameable defect.
rating_anchors.7: Good and usable, but a first-pass reviewer can identify a meaningful weakness.
rating_anchors.6: Barely acceptable; the requested relation is readable but an obvious defect remains.
rating_anchors.5: Borderline or unprovable; required evidence is ambiguous, hidden, cropped or internally tense.
rating_anchors.4: Clearly wrong at first inspection; structure, state or relation visibly conflicts.
rating_anchors.3: Major failure with only partial remnants of the intended relation.
rating_anchors.2: Severe failure or multiple coupled errors.
rating_anchors.1: Almost entirely unusable for this dimension.
